propositions: _ref_lock.py is pinned at exactly 800 LOC, the hard CI gate limit, leaving zero margin for any new change
A bug fix required two additional lines to _NON_CAS_REJECT_MARKERS but could not fit; the file must be split to restore development headroom
The split must preserve module identity and test monkeypatch behavior by moving code through the lazy_load seam and keeping wrapper functions in the parent

Moving seven functions (_PUSH_REJECT_MARKERS, _LEASE_MISMATCH_MARKER, _NON_CAS_REJECT_MARKERS, _is_cas_mismatch_stderr, _push_lease_cas, _push_cas, _push_delete_cas) to _ref_lock_push.py reduces _ref_lock.py to 730 LOC while maintaining call-site compatibility

Late binding via explicit core module argument and call-time attribute lookup ensures monkeypatch.setattr(_ref_lock, '_git', ...) intercepts child functions and logging stays on rebar_reconciler._ref_lock logger
